Completed the standard-depth strategy and audit. The copyable query is on one line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T145334Z/final_strategy.txt); the full rationale and search history are in [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T145334Z/work/audit.md).

The cutoff-bound query returns **870 records** through the 2017-11-29 PubMed entry-date cutoff. It retrieved all **7/7** screened development records; that is relative recall on a small, non-independent set, not sensitivity. Two internal PRESS-structured reviews found no issues. An information specialist’s PRESS peer review is still needed before use.
